summary: Improved type safety, error handling, and documentation. Added `logging` for observability. Added `__slots__` for memory optimization. Enhanced validation in `__init__` for `RuntimeContext` and its `crdt` attribute. Added detailed docstrings for all methods. Improved error logging with `exc_info=True` for debugging. Added type hints (`Final`) for module-level constants. Made dynamic attribute access more robust with explicit type checks and default values.
